slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: SpaceX acquired Cursor, an AI coding startup, for $60 billion in an all-stock deal on 17 Jun 2026.
This acquisition is expected to boost SpaceX's competitive edge in AI coding.
The deal was announced just days after SpaceX's IPO, which valued the company at $1.77 trillion.
SpaceX's market cap has surged past $2 trillion, making the acquisition look nearly free.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: This acquisition is significant for the AI industry, as it highlights the growing importance of AI coding in space exploration.
SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor is expected to accelerate the development of AI-powered systems for space missions.
The deal also underscores the increasing competition in the AI coding market, with major players like SpaceX and others investing heavily in AI research and development.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: SpaceX's acquisition of Cursor is a strategic move to enhance its AI capabilities.
The deal is expected to have a significant impact on the AI industry, with potential applications in space exploration and other fields.
As the AI industry continues to evolve, we can expect to see more acquisitions and partnerships like this one.

lines: The EU AI Act Guidelines for high-risk systems were released on 17 Jun 2026.
The guidelines provide a framework for the development and deployment of high-risk AI systems.
The guidelines cover aspects such as data quality, transparency, and human oversight.
The guidelines are expected to have a significant impact on the development of AI systems in the EU.

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Tringbox, an AI startup, has raised ₹5 crore in funding to bring AI-powered music intelligence to India's commercial spaces.
The funding will be used to expand Tringbox's operations and develop its AI-powered music platform.
Tringbox's platform uses AI to provide personalized music recommendations for commercial spaces.
The company plans to use the funding to increase its market share in the Indian commercial music market.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: Tringbox's funding is a significant development for the AI industry in India.
The company's AI-powered music platform has the potential to disrupt the commercial music market in India.
The funding will enable Tringbox to expand its operations and develop its platform further.
